title: Synergistic effect of the low-carbon city and sci-tech finance pilots on green innovation in China
core_idea: Investigate how low-carbon city (LCC) and sci-tech finance city (STFC) pilot policies, individually and jointly, relate to green innovation in Chinese cities, and examine underlying mechanisms (e.g., government technology funding, environmental regulation, venture capital agglomeration), sequencing effects, and heterogeneity using panel data for 278 cities (2006–2021) with a multi-period DID design.
tldr: Analyzes whether and how LCC and STFC pilot policies, alone and in combination, are associated with green innovation across Chinese cities, focusing on mechanisms, sequencing, and heterogeneous effects using 2006–2021 city-level data and a multi-period DID approach.
